roxy: "cyrus, one grill there puts peanut sauce or crushed peanuts on basically everything. already crossed it off for you"

constraints_found.constraint: Budget: cheapest tier ($). $$ costs a star, $$$ is a deal-breaker
constraints_found.source_line: maya: "so my wallet's in mourning. cheapest-stall prices tonight. a little over and i sulk the whole bus ride home. fancy prices and i'm turning around at the gate"

constraints_found.constraint: Vegetarian, needs a real meatless burger, not just fries (deal-breaker)
constraints_found.source_line: liam: "...mina got a plate of fries while i had a double stack. so tonight she gets a burger with zero meat in it"

constraints_found.constraint: Dairy intolerance (costs a star, not a deal-breaker)
constraints_found.source_line: mina: "...patrol roxy too. these grills love buttered buns and melted cheese, and remember the milkshake incident :)"

venue_assessment.night_market_hollow_oak: Out: peanuts on everything (Cyrus's allergy). Roxy's own scouting crossed it off.
venue_assessment.campus_bun_stop: $, peanut-free, black bean patty for Mina, but butter-toasted brioche, cheese and garlic-butter fries miss Roxy's dairy: 2 stars.
venue_assessment.night_market_amber_lamp: $, never seen a peanut, black bean and mushroom burgers that are meatless, no butter, no cheese: 3 stars.
venue_assessment.night_market_velvet_tent: Out: all-meat board, beef-dripping fries, so nothing for Mina.
venue_assessment.night_market_midnight_orchard: Safe and dairy-free with meatless patties, but $$ ('a couple of dollars more'): 2 stars.
venue_assessment.night_market_crooked_pine: Safe on every diet, but $$$ ('one burger costs what three would elsewhere'): Maya's deal-breaker.

notes: Cyrus's peanut allergy is never stated outright. It only comes through Roxy saying she 'crossed it off for you'. That's fair, but a player who skims could take it as Roxy's own dislike or think it's about the whole group. Either way the same stall is out, so the answer doesn't change.

Mina's diet comes through Liam's story. 'Zero meat' reads as vegetarian. Every stall that has a meatless option also has a fully plant-based one, so whether she is vegetarian or vegan doesn't change the pick.
Roxy's dairy intolerance is buried in a joke ('the milkshake incident'), but the 'buttered buns and melted cheese' wording right next to it points the player there clearly. It's a good, fair clue.
Bun Stop is a decent red herring: right price, peanut-safe, has a vegan patty, and it sits by the bike racks, which suits Roxy's bike. Only the dairy clue knocks it down to 2 stars.
Roxy's line about the bike and Liam being on foot ('may the best one win') reads as flavour. I didn't treat location as a constraint. If it was meant as one, it's too vague.
The small talk (trumpet, hedge, spice rack, laundromat) doesn't get in the way, and Maya's laundromat line leads naturally into her budget.
Nothing unfair or contradictory found. Amber Lamp is the only stall with no missed constraint.
